notes: Separate native-green pure official-API Annex C.4 witnesses use schema-valid, adapter-owned FOM modules. One combines an identical same-named dimension with a unique dimension and queries both named handles and upper bounds after Join. The other combines one dimension with a declaration differing only in upperBound, expects InconsistentFOM, and retries a valid Create. Each module creates independently. Installed-package CTest and direct runner passed 8/8 each across both callback models. Java parity compiles against the API-only JAR, and both focused packaged Umbra JNI runtime scenarios passed (out/java-tck/dimension-duplicate-union-jni-20261021.json and out/java-tck/dimension-duplicate-conflict-jni-20261021.json). Other Java providers, note-content differences, other dimension sub-elements, interoperability, and conformance remain outside this slice.
